definitions.gloss: lady; gentlewoman; woman of refined character
definitions.explanation: A woman of good breeding and graceful manners. Used in formal or literary contexts to describe an elegant, well-mannered woman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{淑女|しゅくじょ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧ふるまった。
⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧{淑女|しゅくじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧さま、⟦ようこそ→ようこそ：27879_youkoso⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{淑女|しゅくじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧きた。
examples.english: My grandmother was raised with the education of a lady from a young age.

notes:
{淑女|しゅくじょ} is a formal, somewhat literary word for a refined, well-mannered woman. It is rarely used in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Most frequently encountered in the set phrase ⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧{淑女|しゅくじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧さま (ladies and gentlemen), used at formal events and ceremonies.

PAIR WORD:
- ⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧: gentleman (male counterpart)

REGISTER:
Formal, literary, or old-fashioned. In everyday speech, ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ (woman) is far more common. {淑女|しゅくじょ} carries connotations of elegance, modesty, and good upbringing that make it sound ceremonial or bookish in casual contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: woman (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{婦人|ふじん}→婦人：01658_fujin⟧: lady, woman (formal, seen in signage and formal writing)
- レディー: lady (loanword, casual)
